note: Ground truth for discovery quality. `expect` lists skills a correct run must surface; matching is case-insensitive on repo and name. `forbid` encodes defects that were found and fixed, so a regression fails loudly instead of quietly degrading results. Cases run against the live ecosystem on purpose: a discovery tool that only passes against a frozen fixture is not being tested on the job it does.

cases.why: forbids the anti-trigger-clause defect: a spreadsheet skill matched a Python query because it declared itself wrong for Python
reverse direction: a testing skill must not ride star inheritance into a spreadsheet query
